name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell overhand against your thighs with a slight bend in your knees.
Brace your trunk and draw the bar gently against your thighs with straight arms.
Push your hips straight back as you slide the bar down close to your legs until you feel a firm hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips powerfully forward and squeeze your glutes to stand tall again.
tips: Keep the slight bend in your knees steady throughout the hinge rather than squatting down.
Stop lowering as soon as your hips stop moving back so your lower back never rounds.
